items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: Seems like I remember Frank Netto. I think I remember Frank playing in the Two Bits Club.

ctx.x: Who were some of the bass players that you liked when you were a boy? Do you remember some of them here?
No, I can't remember any of them. No, I can't. There were... Well, wait now. I remember... Seems like I remember Frank Netto. I think I remember Frank playing in the Two Bits Club. Yeah, it cost me.
Yeah, okay. I was wondering, you told me once before about Pops Foster, that you'd heard him on the record. You...
